game_name: Fatal Fury 3 - Road to the Final Victory / Garou Densetsu 3 - Haruka-naru Tatakai (NGM-069 ~ NGH-069)
general_issues: Select fatfury3.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
